title: Derive plan conflict candidates and record verdicts on the workflow record
action: Per D5, the derivation and the verdict record. New verb pair under the state group, registered in the dispatch table of set_gate.rs (pattern: set_gate.rs:59 `["plan-rev", "bump", ..] => ("plan-rev.bump", 2),` and :93 `"plan-rev.bump" => run_plan_rev_bump(flags, use_json, t0),`): `bee state plan-conflicts derive` and `bee state plan-conflicts verdict --id <candidate> --verdict compatible|conflicts|retires-prior [--note <text>]`, both lane-targeted like plan-rev bump (set_gate.rs:857 `mutation_lane_selector`), implemented in a new src/verbs/state_group/plan_conflicts.rs (register in state_group/mod.rs). DERIVE: read the feature's open and capped cells from .bee/cells/<id>.json (feature match) — titles, files, affects_skills, affects_specs; build the term set from cell titles and path stems; candidates are (1) every active decision that `conflict_candidates` (decisions/read.rs:454) or a `count_term_hits` (:436) score of >=2 selects for that term set, and (2) every rule home from knowledge::ownership::load_ownership whose home or applied_at intersects the cells' files or affects_*; write `conflict_review: {plan_rev: <current>, derived_at, candidates: [{id, kind: decision|rule, title, verdict: null, note: null}]}` onto the workflow record (record.rs:194 is where plan_rev lives; add the field beside it, seeded absent) under the same locks plan-rev bump takes (set_gate.rs:845 `run_plan_rev_bump`); re-deriving replaces the list and clears verdicts. VERDICT: set one candidate's verdict and note; an unknown id or verdict value refuses by name; the JSON output is the whole conflict_review. Zero candidates is a valid derive (empty list) — that is the only state in which '0 conflicts' is true (D5). Help text for both spellings in src/generated/registry_payload.json and the catalog count in src/catalog.rs (the registry drift test pins them). Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/gates.md with the new record field and the two verbs (Business Rules + Pointers). Tests in state_group/tests.rs (pattern: tests.rs:1392 `a_plan_rev_bump_flips_the_stamped_gate_in_the_same_projection`): derive on a fixture with one matching decision and one matching rule home yields two null-verdict candidates; derive with nothing matching yields []; verdict sets exactly one; re-derive clears verdicts; unknown id refuses.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee state_group && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts

bee state plan-conflicts verdict sets one candidate's verdict and refuses an unknown id or verdict value by name
